globals.name: random_item

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: How many items the range has

globals.description: Gives one of count items from first, at random, if the bag has room: 0x8012 is 1 when given, 0 when not (global_10850.s, Script_4)

globals.name: wild_battle
globals.description: A wild battle with the species at four fifths of the lead's level (rounded down to fives), with its cry: 0x8012 is 1, 2 or 3 by the result; a loss blacks out (global_10850.s, Script_5)

globals.name: zone_reload
globals.description: Loads the map again where the player stands, as the Version Key does, after a script sets a place's flag (EVENT_FLAG_BLACK2_*) or the Regi chamber (EVENT_WORK_REGI_CHAMBER): the zone's look and its level scripts follow. 0x8000 is 1 when it did, 0 where it can't (on rails, cycling, surfing, the Union Room, the Entralink). The script's last thing: the map's people are new after it (global_2800.s, Script_24; plugins.md, Version places)
